content: We tuned the parameters based on the best performance on the development set. We fixed the weights of word embeddings during training. All the LSTMs in our neural network use the hidden state size of 300. To avoid overfitting, we applied dropout BIBREF37 with dropout ratio of 0.5 to both input and output of LSTM layers. To prevent the exploding gradient problem in training LSTMs, we adopt gradient clipping with gradient L2-norm threshold of 5.0. These parameters remain the same for all our proposed models as well as our own baseline models.
